lines.en: I glide half a block off the ground
My violet shell hisses through air
I settle low, then rise
I drift forward, hovering
My tail tip rakes the dust
I bank along the current
I do not walk, I float
I slide above your head
My shadow reaches you first
I ease through a slow turn
Ki churns beneath my feet
The air cools as I near
I regard you with lowered eyes
A thread of light sits on my fingertip
I would not lower myself to land
I hover with folded arms
I let out one slow breath
I lift my chin slowly
My tail sways slowly
I am gauging your strength
Light runs over my purple plates
I let out a cold laugh
No rush, I have all the time
I set my shoulder plate straight
I wait for your first word
My ki sits tightly coiled
So this is the little insect
I look down on you
Your ki flickers like a candle
You dare look up at me
I have your face
Are your legs trembling

lines.zh: 我看不出你有什么特别
lines.en: I see nothing special in you

lines.zh: 这里只有一个种族值得我低头
lines.en: Only one race ever earned my respect
I raise one finger
Let me see how long that lasts
I curl my fingers in
You are not worth my landing
I sweep one glance over you
Where are your companions
I smile and shake my head
I will let you finish
You may still regret this
I drift back half a step
A line splits my shell

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你时变了脸色
lines.en: My expression changes as I look at you
That was not what I expected
I spit the blood out
I gather my ki again
My hand is shaking
I did underestimate you
Do not mistake this for a turn
I do not eat such things
You test me with food
Ki is all I require
Take it away, do not soil me
I will not even look at it
That cannot buy a life
You take me for a beast
My appetite is far larger
Offer me a planet instead
I am not hungry, only cleaning up
You hit my chest
I did not move an inch
You are the one who bounced

lines.zh: 我的甲硬得超出你想象
lines.en: My shell is harder than you think
Is your head spinning
I stop you with one palm
The air pops between us
You cannot even push me
My ki settles under me

lines.zh: 碰撞的声响传出去很远
lines.en: The sound carries a long way

lines.zh: 这个种族的事与我无关
lines.en: Such matters are not mine
I keep company with the strong only
My brother is stronger than I
I need no partner
Solitude keeps me sharp
I keep my words to myself
Who is fit to stand beside me
This topic bores me
My line needs no multiplying
I would rather watch others end
I draw it up with ki
This does not deserve my touch
I crush it in one hand
I float it above my palm
I glance and drop it
It dissolves in my hand
I keep it as a marker
I flick it far away
What is this weight to me
I squeeze it slowly
Are you fit to face me
I have your position
Ki gathers at my fingertip

lines.zh: 我抬手的姿势就是答案
lines.en: My raised hand is your answer
This strike holds nothing back

lines.zh: 我先看看你躲不躲得开
lines.en: Let me see if you can dodge
The ground you stand on is too exposed
Hold still while I aim
I will show you the difference

lines.zh: 我的目标从头到尾是你
lines.en: You were always my target
This whole area should be cleared
I have my eyes on you now
You are not worth a second strike
Let us begin, little thing
You run quickly enough
I shift with an afterimage
Look back, I am not there
I have predicted where you land
My finger stays on you
I can read where you dodge
A ki blast sits at my hand
Are you counting my heartbeats
I do not chase, I let you come
Speed will not help you
There is nothing to hide behind
I rise a little for the full view
I count every dodge
I have your rhythm
I draw my ki in slowly
I dim the light around me
You are on my line now
I fire a beam from my palm
My ki blast skims after you
My fist breaks your guard
The aerial combo connects
I slip behind you as an afterimage
A nova blooms overhead
My knee drives into your gut
A string of small blasts flies out
My tail lashes your back
The blast presses you into the ground
I add a wide sweep
Light leaks between my fingers
This one was saved for you
Armor does not stop ki
I knock you into the air
And another follows at once
I drop a little from high above
Ki bursts around me
A violet shape joins the sky
I settle above the field
My ki pushes the wind aside
My shell plates fold in
I look down on this ground
My name needs no repeating
I have come to end this
The clouds part at my gesture
The dust rises upward
The air tightens first
I tap one finger in the air
This place is mine to deal with
I smile down to your eye level
A purple shadow halts midair
I will say this only once
Your god needs replacing
The heat makes my shell glow
I hit the ground and leave a crater
Water wraps me and my ki chokes
The blast scatters my ki
A round taps my shoulder plate
Magic binds my wrist
I spent too much ki and feel the hunger
Lightning crawls over my plates
Falling, even my ki finds nothing
